summary: Job-detail page: no hero, a centered title band, then a two-column body. Left a long description with red sub-headings (responsibilities, requirements, why join) and bullets; right an application form card. Needs a job title, three facts (type, place, schedule), a summary and 3 bullet lists.

sections.note: centered red title and a grey lead on white, no photo
left column about 55%: job title, three meta lines (type, place, schedule), a summary paragraph, then red sub-headings Responsibilities, Job requirements and Why join us, each with a bulleted list
right column about 40%, not sticky: bordered white card with full name, email, phone, a message box, a dashed CV upload box and a full-width red Send my application button
